card.name: Small words in all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: The word A (and occasionally BY, THE, a hyphen) inside all-caps warning text, mostly 'INDIVIDUALS WITH A' before 'HISTORY OF' in penicillin hypersensitivity warnings.

modes.label: A before HISTORY in allergy warnings
modes.description: The article A after 'INDIVIDUALS WITH' or 'AND/OR' in capitalized penicillin hypersensitivity text.
modes.example: THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR IN INDIVIDUALS WITH<< A>> HISTORY OF PENICILLIN HYPER

modes.label: Other small words in capitals
modes.description: Short linking words or hyphens inside other all-caps phrases or headings.
modes.example: KEEP OUT OF<< THE>> REACH OF CHILDREN.

card.plain: It fires on the little word 'a' in capitalized allergy warnings, right before 'history of'.
